title: Album release: Live At The Greek Theatre 2008 by Ringo Starr | 2010
content:
Live At The Greek Theatre 2008, the 11th live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 27 July 2010.

Recorded at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 2 August 2008, it was the final show by the tenth All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America lasted for 29 dates between June and August 2008.

The full 22-song concert was also released as a 5.1 surround sound DVD on the same date, also titled Live At The Greek Theatre 2008.

Page last updated: 31 October 2025
